caption: The drawing shows two main objects: an arched panel and a balustrade. The arched panel is placed in the top left corner and contains the image of a gray and white bird with outstretched wings outlined in black and filled in with light gray shading. Radiating red and yellow lines emerge from behind the bird. The panel has a border with red, orange, and yellow bands, and at the base of the panel, the letters "A" and "R" appear on either side of the bird. Below the bird, there are alternating yellow and red dots forming a horizontal line. Below the panel, a balustrade stretches horizontally across the image, constructed from stylized geometric balusters. The balusters are alternating shapes in red, gray, and beige colors, with a red stripe running along the top rail and gray on the bottom rail, along with a ball finial at the right end, painted with red and gray bands. The background is an off-white or cream color, and there are no other objects or textures depicted. The number "10" is printed in the lower left corner.
title: Plate 10: Holy Ghost Lunette & Altar Rail, Chimayo: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
